title: Software Engineer
intro: I'm Hans, a software engineer focused on backend systems and data-heavy applications. I shipped Production Intelligence V4, a platform that ingests 420M+ machine vision inspections a year, and cut its dashboard load times from 10s to 0.1s and its storage costs by 92%.

roles.title: Software Engineer
roles.description: Shipped Production Intelligence V4, a platform that ingests 420M+ machine vision inspections a year. Cut dashboard load times from 10s to 0.1s by rendering and caching pages on the server. Containerized the stack and deployed it on AWS with Docker.

roles.title: Student Software Developer
roles.description: Prototyped the data ingestion pipeline behind Production Intelligence V4 and evaluated columnar storage formats that later cut storage costs by 92%. Shipped backend features in production while finishing my MSc.

roles.title: Student Software Developer
roles.description: Built a pipeline that renders synthetic images to train two deep learning models for object detection and 6DoF pose estimation of parts in a bin. Released as the open source project BlenderBin at github.com/hansaskov/BlenderBin.

roles.title: Software Developer
roles.description: Collected and analyzed data from distributed IoT devices. Built a website that shows the data in real time so the team could monitor their products.

roles.title: MSc in Software Engineering
roles.description: Specialized in distributed systems and backend engineering, with electives in cybersecurity and biometric security.

roles.title: BEng in Robotic Systems
roles.description: Found my love for software and mathematics through control theory, computer vision, and machine learning. Programmed a UR5 robot arm to detect, grasp, and throw objects with collision-aware motion planning.
